title: fieldsecurityprofile
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, solution_fieldsecurityprofile.

createdon.description: Date and time when the profile was created.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the profile was last modified.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the profile.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the role.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the profile.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the profile.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the associated organization.
